about: English specs and build status of the Spell Revisions batch decisions (cbmagic_sr.tpa and decided follow-ups), by decision-page row.

parts.spec: Duration is 8 hours (2400 seconds) instead of 24 hours (7200 seconds). Its description and scroll say so.
Keeps vanilla's +1 bonus to luck and skill checks (Luck bonus type on luck and saves), lasts 15 rounds (90 seconds) instead of 3 rounds, and replaces an earlier casting on the same target.

Usable indoors and outdoors; grants the caster dispellable immunity to backstab for 3 rounds at level 5 plus 1 round per 2 caster levels up to 10 rounds at level 19 instead of revealing the outdoor map.

Renamed Invisibility Sphere in spell and scroll names and descriptions, casting time is 1 (from 9), duration is 1 turn (60 seconds, from 24 hours), and uses an ally-only radius-110 projectile (cbminv10.pro via ADD_PROJECTILE).

Duration is 4 rounds (24s) at levels 1-14, 5 rounds (30s) at levels 15-19, and 6 rounds (36s) at level 20+, preserving existing ability breakpoints. Save vs. Spell at -2 and everything else stay vanilla.
Minor Sequencer belongs to the Universal school, so all specialist mages (including Diviners) can learn and cast it.
Range is 30 ft. (from 40 ft.) and allows a Save vs. Spell at -4 to avoid being teleported (vanilla: no save). Its description and scroll say so.

Dispels illusion spells up to 9th level (from 5th) in a 30-ft (radius 450) enemy-only area centered on the caster (range 1, projectile cbmoracl.pro via ADD_PROJECTILE), and lists the affected high-level illusions in its description.
Contingency belongs to the Universal school, so all specialist mages can learn and cast it.
Chaos (SPWI508, level 5) keeps its Save vs. Spell at -4 and enemy-only area, with duration set to 4 rounds (24s) at levels 1-14, 5 rounds (30s) at levels 15-19, and 6 rounds (36s) at level 20+.

Sphere of Chaos (SPWI711, level 7) keeps its name, level 7, point targeting within range 40 ft., and 10-round enemy-only field. Each round, enemies in the area save vs. Spell at -4 or suffer one of 5 random effects for 1 round (6s): feeblemind (20%), confusion (20%), panic (20%), sleep waking on damage (20%), or hold (20%).
Spell Sequencer belongs to the Universal school, so all specialist mages can learn and cast it.
Spell Trigger belongs to the Universal school, so all specialist mages can learn and cast it.
Chain Contingency belongs to the Universal school, so all specialist mages can learn and cast it.
Stays vanilla; base game already matches the decided mechanics and duration.

Replaces the opcode-129 Aid payload with a hit-point-only bonus (opcode 18, min(L,10) + 1d8 with L = max(ability level, 3)), lasting 1 turn per level (60*L seconds), refreshing on recast, and displaying its own portrait icon via STATDESC.2DA (BAM SPPR150D).
Casting time is 5 (from 9), duration is 30 seconds + 1 round per caster level across 20 abilities (levels 1-20, 36-150 seconds), usable by clerics and druids as in vanilla. Its description says so.
Favor bonus-type non-stacking (+1 THAC0, damage, and saves against Fear) via cbmagic_bonus.tpa and M_CBMBON.lua.

Priest level-7 Confusion (SPPR709) becomes priest Sphere of Chaos, matching wizard Sphere of Chaos (SPWI711): 10-round enemy-only field within range 40 ft. where enemies save vs. Spell at -4 each round or suffer one of 5 random 1-round effects (feeblemind, confusion, panic, sleep waking on damage, or hold).
Stays vanilla; base game SPPR508 is already usable by both clerics and druids and already protects against Maze.

Renamed Divine Power in name and description, casting time 4 (from 6), grants single/multi-class non-fighter clerics dispellable fighter bonus attacks per round (+1/2 APR at levels 7-12, +1 APR at level 13+), 18/00 Strength floor via M_CBMSTR.lua, and Transformation-family mutual exclusion.

Casting time is 1 (from 9), imposes -2 to THAC0, damage rolls, and all saving throws (Curse bonus type, no AC penalty), and allows a Save vs. Spell to negate, with the save penalty scaling from 0 at level 1 to -4 at level 9 (steps at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9).

New level-1 druid-only spell added via ADD_SPELL (CLERIC_CBMAGIC_FAERIE_FIRE), using base-game icons SPPR309C/SPPR309B and ability location 2. Hostile 5-ft (radius 75) enemy-only area (cbmffir.pro via ADD_PROJECTILE), casting time 1, range 20, duration 4 rounds (24s), Save vs. Spell negates: -2 AC penalty, cures and prevents invisibility, and outlines targets in a violet glow.

Usable by druids and rangers as well as clerics, lasts 1 turn/level (60s/level across all timed protections and companion state/stat/visual effects), protects against Stun, and no longer blocks Haste or movement bonuses.

New level-5 druid-only spell added via ADD_SPELL (CLERIC_CBMAGIC_MASS_REGENERATE), using base-game icons SPPR711C/SPPR711B and ability location 2. Sight-range party-only area centered on the caster (projectile cbmmreg.pro via ADD_PROJECTILE, radius 452), casting time 5, regenerates 2 HP per round (1 HP per 3s) for 1 turn + 2 rounds/level (up to 30 rounds at level 10), replaces an earlier casting of itself, and participates in Regeneration-family mutual exclusion.

Cures poison and grants immunity to poison for 1 turn/level (420-1200s across levels 7-20); no longer heals 10 HP or cures disease, paralysis, blindness, or deafness (removing non-self opcode 321 disease/paralysis resource removals).

Summons a Deva (DEVAIMO / CBHPDEVA) for 5 rounds + 1 round/level with SR celestial avatar, stats, mace, and vanilla-equivalent priest/innate spellbook, subject to a 1-deva party cap shared with Summon Fallen Deva.

Summons a Fallen Deva (DEVAEVIL / CBHPDEVA) for 5 rounds + 1 round/level with SR celestial avatar, stats, mace, and vanilla-equivalent priest/innate spellbook, subject to a 1-deva party cap shared with Summon Deva.
Silence 15' Radius affects enemies only (projectile SPARBLNP instead of all-creatures SPKLARBL). Its description says so.
Iron Skins is named Stoneskin, has casting time 1 (from 9), and keeps vanilla's skin progression and duration.
Keeps vanilla mechanics and is restricted to druids (cleric/paladin usability excluded).

Restricted to druids, stays level 7, heals 2 HP per second (from 3) for 1 round per level (from 1 round per 2 levels), replaces an earlier casting on the same target, and leads the Regeneration family.

Keeps vanilla cures, casting time (3), and caster fatigue drawback, and additionally cures Hold, Stun, Sleep, Petrification (before the full heal), Polymorph, curses, Blindness, Deafness, and ability-score drain (via M_CBMRES.lua).
Lasts 1 turn per level (420-1200 seconds across levels 7-20), usable by both clerics and druids, otherwise vanilla.
